bodyHtml:
📡 IT Technicians, Not Just Antenna Installers · Gold Coast & Surrounds

Starlink Installation Gold Coast. Dish, Cabling & Whole-Home WiFi, Done Right.

Professional dish mounting, cable routing, router setup and whole-home WiFi coverage across the Gold Coast. We're IT technicians, not just antenna installers, so the job doesn't stop when the dish is on the roof, we optimise it for your whole home, office or extended property. Others say it's out of their hands once the equipment's installed. We offer a complete solution.

Get Me Connected
✓ Site Survey
✓ Dish Mounting
✓ Cable Routing
✓ Router & WiFi Setup
✓ Network Integration
Why It Matters

Starlink Is Sold As DIY. There's A Catch.

The dish needs a completely clear view of the sky, the cable has to get from your roof into the house without leaks or damage, and if anything goes wrong, Starlink's only support channel is an online portal, not much help when your internet isn't working.

Our Approach

We Don't Stop When The Dish Is On The Roof.

Computers Gold Coast installs and configures Starlink systems across the Gold Coast. We're IT technicians, not just antenna installers, so we set up your router, fix WiFi dead spots, hardwire your devices, and make sure every corner of your home or office gets fast, stable internet.

What's Included

What's Included In Our Starlink Installation Service.

📡

Site Survey & Obstruction Check

We use the Starlink app and our own experience to find the mounting spot with the clearest view of the sky. Trees, chimneys and neighbouring rooflines all degrade your signal.

⚒️

Dish Mounting

Roof, ridgeline, wall, pole or gutter mount, whichever suits your property. All mounts are weatherproofed and secured to handle Queensland storms.

🔌

Cable Routing & Entry

We run the cable neatly, drill a single clean entry point, seal it against water, and hide the run where possible. No cables dangling down your walls.

📶

Router & WiFi Setup

We position and configure the Starlink router, connect your devices, run speed tests, and confirm everything works before we leave.

🏠

Whole-Home WiFi Coverage

The standard Starlink router struggles in larger and multi-storey homes. We install mesh systems and WiFi access points for full coverage.

🌐

Ethernet & Network Integration

Need a hardwired connection for gaming, a work computer or a business network? We integrate the dish with your existing network gear.

Why Get It Professionally Installed?

Plenty Of DIY Installs Go Fine. Here's What Sends People To Us.

  • Partial obstructions, the dish went up in a spot that isn't fully clear, and the connection drops every few minutes.
  • Damaged or leaking cable runs, the cable was run through a window or door seal and got crushed or let water in.
  • Roof risk, climbing a two-storey roof turned out to be more dangerous than expected.
  • Dead WiFi zones, the WiFi works near the router and nowhere else.
  • It just felt too hard, the kit arrived and the whole install felt like more than a weekend job.

A professional install costs less than replacing damaged equipment (the standard kit is worth around $549 if you break it), and a lot less than a hospital visit from a roof fall. You get it done right the first time: correct placement, sealed penetrations, tested speeds, and working WiFi through the whole property.

Get Me Connected
Pricing

What Affects Starlink Installation Cost.

Every property is different, so we give you a straight quote over the phone before we book the job. No hidden fees.

🏠

Mount Type & Roof Access

Roof, ridgeline, wall, pole or gutter mount. Roof height and access difficulty affect the job.

📏

Cable Routing Length

Distance from the dish to your router location, wall type, and whether internal routing is possible.

📶

WiFi & Network Extras

Standard router setup is included in every job. Mesh systems, access points and ethernet integration cost extra.

💼

Business & Commercial Setups

Multi-router networks, hardwired business connections and commercial premises are quoted individually.

Get in touch and we'll give you a straight quote over the phone.

Is Starlink Right For You?

Starlink On The Gold Coast & Regional Queensland.

Starlink delivers high-speed, low-latency internet from a network of low Earth orbit satellites, with typical download speeds well above 100 Mbps and latency around 25 to 30 ms. For rural and semi-rural properties around the Gold Coast hinterland, Tamborine Mountain, Canungra and the Currumbin Valley, where NBN fixed line never arrived, it's often the fastest option available. It's also a strong backup connection for businesses that can't afford downtime.

As at mid-2026, Starlink residential plans in Australia start from around $75 per month, with hardware available as a free rental (you pay shipping) or an outright purchase. Roam plans suit caravans and 4WD setups. Pricing and promotions change regularly, so check starlink.com/au for current offers at your address. We install the dish and set up your network, you keep your Starlink account and billing directly with Starlink, so there's no middleman markup on your plan.

  • Sky Muster satellite, limited data and high latency.
  • NBN fixed wireless, congestion problems.
  • No NBN connection, nothing available at your address at all.
  • Can't afford downtime, running a business that needs a reliable backup connection.

If you have fibre to the premises, NBN is usually the better and cheaper option. Not sure which camp you're in? Get in touch and we'll give you honest advice for your address before you spend anything on hardware.

Starlink Services We Offer

From A Standard Install To Full Network Integration.

We handle every type of Starlink job, start to finish.

🏠

Residential Starlink Installation

Full dish mounting, cable routing and WiFi setup for Gold Coast homes, start to finish. You just need your Starlink kit ready.

💼

Business & Network Integration

Hardwired connections, bypass mode and integration with your existing business network gear.

🚚

Relocations & Troubleshooting

Moving house or fighting constant dropouts? We reposition badly placed dishes and fix existing Starlink setups.

🌐

Mesh WiFi & Ethernet Setup

Whole-home coverage with mesh systems, access points and hardwired ethernet runs.

Already Have Starlink But The WiFi Is Terrible?

We fix coverage with mesh systems, access points and hardwired connections, and reposition badly placed dishes.

Frequently Asked Questions

Starlink Installation Questions, Answered.

Can I install Starlink myself?

Yes, the kit is designed for DIY. But a successful DIY install depends on having an easy mounting spot with a clear sky view and a simple cable path. Two-storey roofs, tile roofs, tricky cable runs and larger homes with WiFi coverage problems are where professional installation pays for itself.

How much does Starlink installation cost on the Gold Coast?

It depends on the mount type, roof height and access, cable run length, and whether you want extras like mesh WiFi or ethernet. Get in touch and we'll give you a straight quote over the phone. No hidden fees.

Where should the Starlink dish be mounted?

Wherever it gets a full, unobstructed view of the sky. That's usually the roof ridgeline or a pole clear of trees. We check the location with the Starlink app before drilling anything, because even partial obstruction from a branch causes regular dropouts.

How long does installation take?

Most standard installs take 1.5 to 3 hours, including mounting, cabling, router setup and speed testing. Complex jobs with long cable runs or mesh WiFi take longer.

Do I need an electrician to install Starlink?

No. Starlink plugs into a standard power point and the cabling is low voltage. If your preferred router location has no power point nearby, we can advise on options.

Does Starlink work in storms?

The dish is built for harsh weather and keeps working through rain and wind, though very heavy storms can cause brief slowdowns. Correct mounting matters here: a securely fixed, properly weatherproofed install handles Queensland summer storms without drama.

Is Starlink better than NBN?

If you have fibre to the premises, NBN is usually the better and cheaper option. If you're on Sky Muster satellite, fixed wireless with congestion problems, or no NBN at all, Starlink is typically a big upgrade in both speed and latency. We're happy to give honest advice for your address before you spend anything.

I already have Starlink but the WiFi is terrible. Can you help?

Yes, this is one of our most common jobs. We fix coverage with mesh systems, access points and hardwired connections, and we can reposition badly placed dishes.

Ready For Fast Internet Anywhere?

Call Computers Gold Coast or get in touch online for your Starlink installation quote.
